enchantments.tooltip: Potency +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Spell Lore III: Passive: All of your spells gain a 3% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Evocation Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Feeds Off Madness: This item greedily feeds off the aura of madness related to certain Xoriat effects. The more of these its wearer is affected by, the stronger this item will become.
